scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 21 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 12 km this is Emmental Panorama Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

emmental-panorama-road.story: Out of Bern, one way: 68 km, roughly 1 h 06 in the saddle. On the way it passes Burgdorf, Lutzelfluh and Langnau im Emmental. The highest point is about 1,500 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
